Hall of Nonsense
How to play

A patient’s guide to causing trouble.

Keyboard

WASD / arrows: move
Space: attack with what you’re holding
Shift / J: jump over low attacks
Q: dash through trouble
E: spin / shield / trap
1–3: equip · C: next weapon
F: eat a nutrient
M: map · Enter: nearby arcade
Esc: pause

Phones and tablets: the joystick

Turn the phone sideways for the big room
Left thumb: the joystick
SWING / THROW / LOB: tap to hit, hold to keep going, drag to aim
Swipe SWING sideways: next weapon (or tap the weapon strip)
JUMP sits beside it; DASH and spin / shield / trap ride around it
EAT: one nutrient, one heart

Tap the room instead

Tap the floor: walk there
Tap a gremlin: go bonk it. Hold to keep swinging
Flick: dash that way
Two-finger tap: jump
Long-press the floor: spin / shield / trap
Same weapon strip and EAT button

The combo

Land three hits in a row without getting hit or whiffing and the ring around SWING fills. Your next swing near a gremlin is a COMBO SLAM: everything close gets knocked back and dizzy, and you get paid. Taps count; a held button still swings, it just does not count.

Medals matter

Bronze is 1 discharge star, silver 2, gold 3. Only your best medal per level counts. A bronze unlocks the next level. Spend coins in the gift shop.

Health has a budget

Every room has a snack cart (the lounge has a vending machine) good for one nutrient; it restocks after a ward clear or two minutes. Cleared waves, every sixth gremlin and some combo slams leave one on the floor. Carry up to 3 (5 with Pocket snacks); each restores a heart. Still no bottomless snack fountain.

Zero hearts

Macy goes back on the IV. Finish one IV phase to get out of bed. Each collapse makes the next one harder, and a failed recovery gets spectacularly anatomical. Progress survives.
